svg.title: The cubic over the 20 training points as gradient descent runs, and its training loss
svg.text: sin(pi x), which made the points

g.title: Step 0: every weight is 0, so the cubic is the flat line y = 0. Training loss 0.3875, test loss 0.5122.
One step against the gradient: the weights are (0.227, 0.295, 0.073, 0.129), and the training loss has halved, to 0.1896.
Step 2000: weights (0.079, 2.305, -0.135, -2.411). Training loss 0.0104, lower than sin(pi x) itself scores on these points (0.0196); test loss 0.0496.
